_about: The FAQ assistant's evaluation set, run by tests/ask-core.test.js. No bucket may contain a wrong answer. `expect` is an entry id from assets/data/faq.json (or a list of ids that would each be a right answer), or null for a refusal. `gates` is the share each bucket must answer (or, for out-of-scope, refuse); null means report only. exact is every entry's own question. paraphrase was written for this file, not copied from the entries' alt phrasings, and the keywords in faq.json were tuned against it, so it overstates recall. The holdout buckets were written after tuning to measure that honestly: holdout (tuned on afterwards), holdout-2 (tuned on once afterwards), holdout-3 (run once; the one change made after it removed a wrong answer, by keeping negations and "know" as meaningful words).
